# Provenance — Kimi K3.1 Pro (retrieved 2026-10-28 WIB)

Official Moonshot AI blog images (https://www.kimi.ai/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro); no explicit licence; used as credited editorial press material. Originals unmodified in originals/. Processed in processed/ with scripts/blue-ink.mjs (JS port of the old assets/blue_ink.py) (deterministic local tonal gradient map: shadows #12114A → ink #4E4FEB → pale #B9BAF2 → off-white #F2F1EC, fine 45° engraved line texture weighted by darkness, subtle grain; no flat overlay, no generative edits, so documentary/chart content is unchanged).
